newsitem.title: DUBAI: National Bank of Fujairah raises $60 million.
newsitem.headline: National Bank of Fujairah raises $60 million.

text.p: National Bank of Fujairah (NBF) has raised a $60 million loan from a group of international banks led by Germany's Commerzbank), NBF said on Thursday.
The loan was priced at LIBOR plus 55 basis points.

"The purpose of the loan is to support further expansion of the bank's corporate business and is seen as a cost-effective way of diversifying the bank's funding sources as well as extending the average maturity of the bank's funds," NBF said in a company statement.
NBF operates four branches in the United Arab Emirates, focusing primarily on trade and corporate finance. Its assets at the end of 1995 stood at $456 million.
